changed.item: Original says extras are 'left to be paid for later' (unspecified payer, stated as consequence); edit says they 'could be left for your family to pay for later', adding a payer and softening certainty to 'could'
'Hard to change' softened to 'awkward to change', which understates the difficulty slightly
'Worth thinking carefully before you sign' became 'take your time before you sign anything', shifting the emphasis from careful consideration to not rushing

added.item: Your family will be the ones paying for the extras
